label: #3587661: Missing labels in "Limited files with a single pre-existing value (required) field.", pinned core
description: A file field that allows more than one value, with "Enable Display field" on, shows each uploaded file in a table. The checkbox in its "Display" column has no label and no accessible name. After (MR !16335) adds an aria-label; the 3587661-proposal variant keeps a visually hidden label instead.
status: draft: Before and both Afters were run by script on 11.x (21e0dcba) on 2026-10-19, in Default Admin and Claro, with PHPUnit (without and with Inline Form Errors) and PHPCS (EVIDENCE.md); not yet built in DDEV, and no person has done the keyboard or screen reader pass

steps.text: The recipe adds one file field to Article, "Files (two values)", with "Enable Display field" on, and hides the Image field on the form.
Open /node/add/article (loaded in both frames once you press Go).
In EACH frame, upload a small .txt file to "Files (two values)". A file chooser cannot be mirrored, so do this by hand in each frame.
steps.lookFor: The file appears in a table with a "Display" column holding a checkbox.

steps.text: In each frame, inspect that checkbox (or press Run checks), then Tab to it and listen with a screen reader if you have one.
steps.lookFor: Inspect the checkbox's wrapper div, not only the input. Before: the wrapper holds the input alone (no name). After: a <label for> with "Include file in display", visually hidden, sits just before the input.

expected: The "Include file in display" checkbox in the Display column of a multiple-value file field has an accessible name.
actual: Before: the checkbox has no label and no accessible name, and axe reports "label". Single-value fields are not affected (shown by the first runs, when the recipe also had a one-value field). Run 2026-10-19 on 11.x (21e0dcba), EVIDENCE.md.

checks.label: The display checkbox of "Files (two values)" is on the page (upload a file in each frame first)
That checkbox's label or aria-label is "Include file in display"
JavaScript errors on the page (ignoring the harmless ResizeObserver loop notice)

observe.label: A screen reader announces the Display checkbox with a name
The table looks the same as before (no visible label text added)

label: #3587661: same steps against the LATEST core main
#3587661: the visually hidden label proposal (FileThemeHooks) with its test, pinned core
description: Instead of the MR's aria-label: keep the checkbox's own label in the multiple-value table and hide it visually (#title_display = 'invisible' in FileThemeHooks::preprocessFileWidgetMultiple()), with a test in FileFieldDisplayTest that checks the label on the edit form and after a save error, without and with Inline Form Errors.
